mapper.select: select 'dish' productType,d.id productId,d.name,d.price,d.image, n.profile_version profileVersion,n.recipe_version recipeVersion, n.energy_kcal energyKcal,n.protein_g proteinG,n.fat_g fatG, n.carbohydrate_g carbohydrateG,n.dietary_fiber_g dietaryFiberG, n.sugar_g sugarG,n.sodium_mg sodiumMg,n.purine_mg purineMg, n.data_completeness dataCompleteness from dish d join dish_nutrition_profile n on n.id=( select n2.id from dish_nutrition_profile n2 where n2.dish_id=d.id and (n2.verification_status='VERIFIED' or (#{allowSimulated}=true and n2.verification_status='SIMULATED')) and (n2.effective_from is null or n2.effective_from<=now()) and (n2.effective_until is null or n2.effective_until>now()) order by n2.profile_version desc limit 1) where d.status=1 and d.price <= #{budget} union all select 'setmeal' productType,s.id productId,s.name,s.price,s.image, n.snapshot_version profileVersion,0 recipeVersion, n.energy_kcal energyKcal,n.protein_g proteinG,n.fat_g fatG, n.carbohydrate_g carbohydrateG,n.dietary_fiber_g dietaryFiberG, n.sugar_g sugarG,n.sodium_mg sodiumMg,null purineMg, 100 dataCompleteness from setmeal s join setmeal_nutrition_snapshot n on n.id=( select n2.id from setmeal_nutrition_snapshot n2 where n2.setmeal_id=s.id and (n2.verification_status='VERIFIED' or (#{allowSimulated}=true and n2.verification_status='SIMULATED')) order by n2.snapshot_version desc limit 1) where s.status=1 and s.price <= #{budget} order by productType,productId
select dish_id dishId,allergen_code allergenCode,declaration_status declarationStatus from dish_allergen_declaration where dish_id in #{id}
select di.dish_id dishId,fi.ingredient_code ingredientCode,fi.name ingredientName from dish_ingredient di join food_ingredient fi on fi.id=di.ingredient_id where di.dish_id in #{id}

select distinct di.dish_id dishId,s.weight from dish_ingredient di join seasonal_ingredient_rule s on s.ingredient_id=di.ingredient_id and s.status=1 where di.dish_id in #{id} and (s.region_code=#{regionCode} or s.region_code='CN') and ((s.start_month<=s.end_month and #{month} between s.start_month and s.end_month) or (s.start_month>s.end_month and (#{month}>=s.start_month or #{month}<=s.end_month)))
